$comment: Shared expectations for the narration validator spec v1: scripts/pack/80-validate.mjs (pipeline) and core/content/NarrationValidator.ets (app, task B3) must give these verdicts. ctx.sourceTexts is absent on purpose: claims_quote is pipeline-only and never runs here. Where spec v1 left a detail open the cases pin the behaviour of the merged app port (core/content/NarrationValidator.ets, PR #56): numbers match as substrings, nothing (not even a [pNNN] pause marker) is stripped from the text, possessives are not stripped. expectFailed lists every failed check id in check order (a schema failure stops validation). Hand-made; the narration.validation field is ignored by the validator.
